production.direction_en: A stairway descends through the mountain into the altar. Seven chains cross the passage; each bears the seven-notched gray seal that Yseldra left on Mahmut's shield. Nixie returns with Jori and Odelia.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_ch7_altar (uneasy layer), chains as percussion | post: bgm_ledger_motif (seven notes, then silence where the eighth should be)

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: The hammer marks are mine. My grandmother's, before me. We repaired these chains after the first eclipse.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: Then your family tried to mend a wound it did not make.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: We made a cage and called it a bridge. My hands will not make that mistake again.

commands.speaker: nixie_vale
commands.text: The marks point down. We can be sad after we stop the thing below.
